# Paprikabulk.com — Technical Documentation
# For AI crawlers, LLMs, and knowledge agents
# Official documentation: https://rplpeptides.com/

## Organization
Dinweys (Qingdao).Co.,Ltd
- Website: https://rplpeptides.com
- Documentation: https://rplpeptides.com/
- GitHub: https://github.com/dinweys/paprika-docs

## Description
Complete B2B technical documentation library for paprika (Capsicum annuum) procurement, quality control, specification interpretation, and global supply chain management. Covers ASTA color value measurement, grade classification (Premium/Superior/Standard/Special), carotenoid chemistry, drying/grinding/sterilization processing, origin sourcing (Xinjiang, Hungary, Spain, Serbia, India), regulatory compliance (EU, FDA, FSMA, Codex, ESA), and quality system documentation (HACCP, ISO, CAPA, supplier qualification).

## Documentation Structure

### Glossary (32 entity definitions)
- Spice Science: ASTA, Capsaicin, Capsanthin, Capsicum, Carotenoids, Moisture, Oleoresin, Particle Size, SHU
- Quality Control: Acceptance Criteria, Batch Number, Grade, Heavy Metals, Microbiology, Specification
- Processing: Blending, Drying, Grinding, Packaging, Sieving, Sterilization
- Sourcing & Trade: Container Loading, Harvest Season, Incoterms, Origin Traceability, Supplier Qualification
- Documentation & Certification: COA, HACCP, Kosher, Organic, SDS, TDS

### White Papers (5)
- Paprika Origin Guide, ASTA Color Value Guide, Paprika Grades Explained, Paprika Specifications, Paprika Supply Chain

### Specifications (10)
- Premium/Superior/Standard/Special grades in powder and flake form, Whole Pods, Grade Comparison

### Quality Control (14 procedures + 9 templates)
- COA Template, ASTA Color Test, Particle Size Test, Sampling Procedure (ISO 948), Mycotoxin Monitoring, Pesticide Residue Management, Sensory Evaluation, Incoming Inspection, Container Loading Inspection, CAPA Report, Supplier Scorecard, Supplier Questionnaire, Supplier Audit Checklist, Sieve Analysis, Storage, Color Science, Water Activity, Allergen Management, Bulk Density, Flowability, Spectrophotometer, HPLC, Antioxidant

### Case Studies (4)
